name: Count Vorhees
description: A vampire count who keeps the night road through his ruined estate open to travelers. His own bloodhounds refuse to follow him past the gates.
biography:
The first time Count Vorhees rose from his coffin, the kitchen clock was still running and his hounds were howling to be fed. He remembered his children. He remembered the kennel boy's name. What frightened him was that he could hear the boy's heart through two floors of stone. Before sunset the next day, every servant on the estate had received a year's wages and a letter of dismissal.

Generations later, the villages below the castle still leave a brass bell at each milestone. Ring one after dark and the count will walk you home. His compact with the villages allows him to take blood only from those who freely offer it. On nights when the werewolves come down from the hills, the bells ring almost until dawn.
